One last letter. His dying wish. A promise that will change everything…The bestselling love story that has shattered a million hearts. Prepare to ugly cry over this devastating slow-burn romance that will shatter your heart and stitch it back together piece by piece.

‘An emotional masterpiece that will leave you utterly wrecked in the best possible way’⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
‘I am not ok…this surpassed Fourth Wing as my favorite book’⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'This book ripped my heart out, to put it back together to rip it out one last time'⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

Beckett,

If you're reading this, well, you know the last-letter drill. You made it. I didn't. I need one thing from you: get out of the army and get to Telluride. My little sister Ella's there, raising the twins alone. If I'm gone, that means I can't be there for her. I can't help them through this. But you can. So I'm begging you, as my best friend, go take care of my sister, my family. Please don't make her go through it alone.

Ryan

When Beckett follows his best friend’s dying wish and arrives in the small mountain town of Telluride, he expects grief, guilt, and the weight of a promise he’s not sure he can keep.

What he doesn’t expect is Ella. Fiercely independent and determined to hold her family together, Ella is still reeling from loss after loss. But as Beckett slowly becomes part of her life, their shared grief begins to turn into something neither of them saw coming.

But Ella knows that loving Beckett means risking heartbreak all over again…and this time she's not sure she'll survive.

Perfect for readers who love:
✨Emotional romances that make you cry
✨Slow-burn love stories
✨Small-town romance
✨Military romance
✨Single parent romance
✨Found family
✨Dual POV

❤️‍🩹The Last Letter is an epic slow-burn love story that will break your heart before putting it back together again. Perfect for fans of Colleen Hoover, Nicholas Sparks, and Abby Jimenez.
